content:
Looking at the diameter AB, the angles on one side of it must sum to 180°.

The angles along that half-plane are: 25° (from OB to the right red radius), the shaded sector's angle x (from the right red radius to the vertical radius), 45° (from the vertical radius to the left red radius), 35°, and 35° (down to OA).

So: 25° + x + 45° + 35° + 35° = 180°
x = 180° − 140° = 40°

The probability of landing in the shaded sector equals the ratio of its central angle to the full circle:

P = 40° / 360° = 1/9

\boxed{1/9}
